source: Pew Research Center. 2016. "One-in-Five U.S. Adults Were Raised in Interfaith Homes."
method: Population is current religious tradition (reltrad). qb3 asks which parent was more responsible for the respondent's religious upbringing; this reads the share saying their parents shared it about equally (vs. mother or father more). Respondents volunteering that they were not raised in any religion; don't know/refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted (this recontact reached only 5,000 of the main 2014 RLS's 35,071 respondents). Weighted by the dataset's own `rweight` variable.
